Opponent is 5x Steel plus fast Dragapult, so Fire + Ground coverage is key. Incineroar lead gives Intimidate, Fake Out tempo, and a safe Parting Shot into sweepers. Dragonite adds Multiscale plus Extreme Speed to beat Dragapult's speed.

decisions.thought: 32% SWITCH: aegislash, 21% SWITCH: gholdengo, 18% MOVE: thunderbolt

Incineroar is slower than Dragapult and in a bad matchup to switch out of, facing likely super-effective Ghost STAB. Fake Out is immune and Flare Blitz is resisted, so pivoting with Parting Shot to drop offenses after Intimidate is best.

decisions.thought: Aegislash is at -1 Attack and Special Attack, so this is a safe setup turn. Garchomp threatens a likely knockout with STAB Earthquake, while Dragonite's ExtremeSpeed is immune into Ghost and its Earthquake is weaker.

decisions.thought: 33% SWITCH: dragapult, 26% SWITCH: gholdengo, 19% MOVE: kingsshield

Garchomp has the speed advantage over Aegislash, but Earthquake loses to a likely King's Shield. Swords Dance punishes King's Shield and still threatens a sweep after a -1 hit. Mega Evolving now keeps speed over Aegislash while boosting power.
